title: sprint status in the checkout fallback says 0 done commits on origin/main when the ref was not readable
goal: when the sprint panel's source is checkout, the ETA line of kbmon --status sprints says no ETA because origin/main was not readable, not a count of done commits on origin/main

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import mon_status as m; s={'taken':'x','panels':{'sprint':{'state':'ok','data':{'source':'checkout','behind':None,'landings':[],'sprints':[{'id':'SP-a','title':'T','state':'active','items':{'done':1,'todo':1},'open':[{'id':'ST-b','title':'B','status':'todo'}],'done_at':[],'waiting':[]}]}},'host':{'state':'ok','data':{}}}}; assert not any('0 done commits on origin/main' in l for l in m.answer(s,'sprints')['lines'])
